overview: This captivating docuseries examines Winston Churchill's pivotal role in World War II and the formative events that made him an ideal leader for the era.
title: Churchill at War

overview: Jung Se Ok, a formerly successful neurosurgeon who works as a shadow doctor in an underground surgery clinic after being expelled by her mentor, Choi Duk Hee. Soon, both doctors reunite, reigniting a tense and emotional rivalry.
title: Hyper Knife

overview: Verliebt in Berlin is a Golden Rose-winning German telenovela, starring Alexandra Neldel, along with Mathis Künzler, Tim Sander, and Laura Osswald. It premiered on February 28, 2005, on Sat.1 in most of German-speaking Europe, with its final episode broadcast on October 12, 2007. The series is an adaptation of the Colombian telenovela Yo soy Betty, la fea, written by Fernando Gaitán and produced by RCN TV.
title: Verliebt in Berlin

overview: A high-teen secret romance unfolds when 'Outsider' (an outsider) becomes the manager of the anonymous community app 'Inssa Time' and learns all the secrets of the entire school and joins a group of super popular kids that she desperately wants to get involved with. Kang U Bin is a popular kid among the popular kids and a trainee at a large entertainment agency who is admired by the entire school and is seen as perfect by his classmates. He not only has great visuals but is also good at studying. He seems like a born-to-be superstar who exceeds the webtoon's setting, but he is hiding a secret that no one can find out about. U Bin, who has never been suspected, ends up in an awkward situation because of 'Outssa', whose name is even confusing.
title: Social Savvy Class 101
The Promise of Growing Up Together

overview: Detective Inspector Hulda Hermannsdóttir is given a shocking new murder case whilst having to work with a new partner, and being in the cusp of early retirement.
title: The Darkness

overview: A trilogy of television movies all set on a street named Maple Street.
title: Secrets on Maple Street

overview: With the wedding day approaching, bride Liu Jingzhi is found dead at home under suspicious circumstances. Her fiancé, wealthy businessman Fang Xuewen, is wrongfully accused of her murder and tragically killed in a hail of bullets. However, a sudden, excruciating pain brings him back to consciousness, only to discover that he is trapped in a time loop. Traveling through time and experiencing infinite rebirths, Fang Xuewen vows to uncover the truth behind his wife's tragic death and rewrite the unjust ending to his own life.
title: A Deadly Loop

overview: Sky Arts' much-loved Artist of the Year franchise has added another brushstroke to its canvas with a brand new series of Masterclasses launching later this year. Artist of the Year: Masterclass will feature live tutorials from a host of talented artists who have taken part in Portrait Artist of the Year or Landscape Artist of the Year, as they demonstrate easy-to learn techniques for budding artists at home. Series judge, Tai-Shan Schierenberg, will also take to his easel to teach masterclasses of his own, showing the nation how he approaches an all-important portrait. The new Sky Original series follows the roaring success of Portrait Artist of the Year, the eleventh series of which launched to its biggest audience ever last month. Millions of viewers also tuned in to Portrait Artist of the Week in 2020, which saw celebrities sit live for their portraits during the Covid-19 lockdown. The series went on to break the Guinness World Record last year for the most people painting a portrait at one time as thousands of avid artists painted national treasure, Sir Lenny Henry, to celebrate Portrait Artist of the Year's tenth anniversary. Artists giving masterclasses alongside Tai-Shan Schierenberg include: Gareth Reid, who was crowned Portrait Artist of the Decade last year, Adebanji Alade, Wendy Barratt, Morag Caister, Finn Campbell-Notman, Phoebe Hicks, Christian Hook, Clare Lord, Sara Reeve and Fujiko Rose. Each masterclass will focus on a different subject or technique to help audiences understand the basics of painting and drawing, with classes covering everything from exploring tone and Alla Prima painting to composing a landscape, botanical flowers and even animal portraiture.
title: Artist of the Year: Masterclass

overview: The energetic show will delve into all the camp drama, laughs, and chaos of the jungle and dissect everything that is happening on I'm A Celebrity… Get Me Out Of Here!
title: I'm A Celebrity... Unpacked

overview: Electric Bloom follows three members of a mega-famous pop group, Electric Bloom, as they look back and tell the story of their band and friendship, starting with the day they all met in middle school. The girls go on a journey to becoming the biggest band in the world and the best friends in the universe.
title: Electric Bloom

overview: Vampirina follows a tween vampire girl who leaves the safety of Transylvania to attend a performing arts boarding school. Living amongst humans for the first time, she pursues her passion for music while keeping her vampire secret, something that's made more challenging when her overprotective father charges an overzealous ghost to live with her at the school. The series is based on the books written by Anne Marie Pace and illustrated by LeUyen Pham, and inspired by the Disney Jr. animated series "Vampirina" from Chris Nee.
title: Vampirina: Teenage Vampire

overview: Eight young adults gather for a vacation filled with fun and celebration. Each day they are given a challenge, and if they solve it, they get a reward. If they fail, they get punished. Will they get the vacation they've been dreaming of?
title: Villa Rhodos

overview: Drama detailing one of the most infamous rebellion plots in British history, shattering myths to reveal the largely forgotten, gripping truth behind the Gunpowder Plot.
title: Gunpowder Siege

overview: Nadya's world is crumbling: she is childless, her husband leaves for someone else. After a divorce, a woman decides that she has no reason to live anymore, but at the last moment she is saved by an ambulance called by someone unknown. Having come to her senses, Nadya acquires a wonderful gift - to see people destined for each other by fate. She understands that she must connect couples, and a suitable place of work immediately turns up for her - the registry office. But how can you explain to people who don't suspect anything about Nadya's abilities that they should be together?
title: Будьте счастливы

overview: Former border guard Sasha Dymov returns to his native village of Kordonka after serving time in prison on a false charge. There is nothing left of his past life - his wife left him for her best friend, and it is impossible to return to law enforcement. His faithful comrade Trofimych comes to the rescue - he takes Dymov under his wing and gets him a job as a car mechanic in his workshop. It would seem that there is no more peaceful occupation. But there is a border nearby, secret smugglers' paths, big money, weapons and criminals dreaming of escaping persecution abroad... Only Sasha Dymov can stop this chaos. In addition to criminal showdowns, the hero will have to find a way out of a love triangle. And there will be mysticism in this story.
title: Кордон

overview: The protagonist, special forces soldier Ivan Doronin, learns of the death of his ex-wife, with whom he hardly communicated and only regularly paid child support for his son Misha. Doronin, who was given leave due to being wounded during the release of hostages, goes to his native village of Medvezhye to pick up the child. But on the spot he learns that his wife has another son, from another man. Both boys live with Doronin's stepfather. Ivan remains in the village to formalize guardianship over Misha. At the same time, the hero has to replace his stepfather, who suddenly fell ill, at work as a postman. While delivering mail around the neighborhood, Ivan often finds himself in difficult situations, where his special forces skills come in handy. So, Doronin will have to take care of the peace of the villagers, become a real father not only to his own child, but also to someone else's child, and also enter into an unequal battle with a high-ranking official for the love of a local beauty.
title: Ронин

overview: High school student Sung Seo Yun feels unwanted by her abusive, dysfunctional family. She longs for the means to escape them all, so she buys lottery tickets. One day she wins the ₩5 billion grand prize, but discovers that minors are ineligible to play or collect the winnings. She turns to an older recent transfer student from a rich family for help.
title: Recipient

overview: The story of Algonquin siblings, who spent their youth in an Indian Residential School in the 1960s and who are now trying to make peace with this painful past. From the moment they were forcibly removed from the parents by religious authority to the events that led them back to each other forty-five years later, this dramatic mini-series intertwines different times in their lives to tell the story of one Indigenous family's forced estrangement and the path it took to heal.
title: Pour toi Flora

overview: The small village of Smeilingen lives from the bizarre everyday life of its inhabitants.
title: SMEILINGEN – Ein Dorf wie Du und Ich
Cai Yun Yi San Liu Li Cui

overview: Jen tries out various modes of travel - from bus to boat, and taxi to train.
title: Milkshake! Off We Go!

overview: First-hand accounts from survivors sharing skin-crawling and terrifying stories of unknown intruders secretly living in their homes.
title: Hidden in My House

overview: In 1992, the first murder for hire in Finland's history, by Ilpo Larha, led to a hostage and siege situation that lasted 55 hours after escaping from prison. The story follows these events when DCI Esko Heinonen conducted the negotiation.
title: Piiritys

overview: We meet women who were tricked and forced by partners into committing serious crimes.
title: My Boyfriend Made Me Do It

overview: Hasan Balaban, an Ottoman janissary who participated in the 1683 Siege of Vienna, sought refuge in the Italian village of Moena after being severely wounded. There, with the help of the local people, he survives and becomes a hero in the village. This documentary invites viewers to discover the forgotten story of Balaban, whose life was reshaped by the effects of war, and explore his legacy in the village. It also reveals how the Ottoman Empire left its mark in a different geography after the wa
title: El Turco

overview: Narrated by Tom Hardy, this thrilling three-part series will examine three deadly and successful missions conducted by British special forces units in different parts of the world. Throughout the series, the focus is on the men of the British Special Forces who were in the front lines of these operations. We speak to the soldiers on the ground, hearing their first-hand testimonies of what went down over the few tense days and hours of the mission. It is their story, told through a series of intimate interviews, accompanied by action packed drama recon and fascinating archive footage and stills. High-end drama reconstruction will be an integral element of this series and will help to bring these amazing stories to life. This is full throttle, intense, cinematic and Hollywood style drama but with no scripted dialogue – we will let Tom Hardy and the interviewees do the talking.
title: Special Forces: Most Daring Missions

overview: Popular influencer Wan Xiong unexpectedly suffers from insomnia one night, thinking it will pass, only to realize it's the beginning of a physical and mental battle. As he embarks on this journey, he encounters five boys along the way. Can Wan Xiong uncover the reason for his insomnia through their interactions?
title: Bad to Bed

overview: Though history has long lionised its great leaders and early rulers, being an elite wasn't all glory and prosperity. Even the fiercest General and the most enduring Monarch would be confronted by opposition and upheaval. Some learned the hard way that power is far from absolute, and allegiance, always conditional. Revolutions That Changed History exposes the complex truth behind ancient revolutions and revolts, from the epic, action-packed, bloody battlegrounds to the intimate exchanges between confidants that were powerful enough to turn tides. Episodes include Wat Tyler's Rebellion (Peasant's Revolt), Boudica's Revolt, French Revolution, Third Servile War, American Revolution and Decembrist Revolt.
title: Revolutions That Changed History

overview: The Inspector Hynek Budik as been assigned chief of police in the area on the outskirts of Prague, With detectives Martin Novacek an inexperienced rookie and the inspector Havlik will seek to solve difficult cases of murder.
title: Zlociny Velké Prahy

overview: A group of teenagers met at a hospital and learned that they need to make friends to deal with the problems of suffering different diseases and living in a hospital.
title: Club der roten Bänder

overview: A serial killer nicknamed "The Trucker" is on the loose in the city. He kills young women near intercity highways, takes off their shoes and covers their faces with their hair. Captain Anastasia Olkhovskaya is at a dead end - three bodies already, and no witnesses or evidence. Then a man appears who claims to know where and when the next murder will be committed.
title: В тени больших чисел

overview: After the All-Russian casting, 20 young entrepreneurs were selected to present their solutions to the jury. Ahead of the heroes are a meeting with developers and six weeks of work on the startup
title: Битва стартапов

overview: Relentless sheriffs, trigger-happy gunslingers, steadfast saloon owners and cocky cowboys are all found in the "Lucky Luke" albums, which have influenced entire generations of comic readers. For the three-part series "In the footsteps of Lucky Luke", the French comic author Jul traveled to the USA to trace the role models of the familiar comic characters.

overview: With more Taiwanese students studying at Japanese universities in recent years, Japanese teachers need to better understand these students. When Onizuka is invited for a one-week teaching exchange program at a Taiwanese high school, he is eager for the experience and takes his friend Ryuuji with him. On their first day there, Onizuka and Ryuuji meet Saejima, a local legend.
title: GTO in Taiwan

overview: A special investigative unit tackles everything from mysterious disappearances and shadowy figures to eerie supernatural phenomena.
title: AARO: All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office

overview: In the scorching heat of this summer, a love-filled dining table returns! To celebrate its 10th anniversary, Three Meals a Day, a beloved show known for traveling across the country, is back—fresher and lighter than ever! Chef Cha Seung-won, who can whip up a meal anywhere, and the ever-resourceful handyman Yoo Hai-jin reunite for this cozy series. Where will their new summer "Three Meals House" be this time? The duo's easygoing summer days unfold in a way that will keep you watching. A warm story of shared meals, spanning mountains and seas.
title: Three Meals a Day Light

overview: Dumped overnight, Ji Song Yi is left burdened by the difficulties of single life, part-time jobs, and paying off her newlywed home loan. She keeps up the ruse of being a happily married woman to save herself from being estranged from the married townswomen.
title: Sorry Not Sorry

overview: Yuho, an 18-year-old boy who took refuge in a quiet rural village due to his parents' bankruptcy. Even at a glance, Yuho exudes the image of a boy who grew up only in the city. While walking along the valley path and meditating, he spots a girl (Lina) and a boy (Jin Goo) who appear to be around the same age splashing in the water. Yuho sees beauty and a strange excitement for the first time in his life as he sees their sparkling figures together with Yunseul in the valley...
title: Buddy Boy

overview: The Grim Reaper appears as the person you love the most before you die. In front of 24-year-old Hee Wan who had no will to carry on and lived as a social outcast, her childhood friend as well as her first love Ram Woo appears as a Grim Reaper and tells her she will die in a week. Hee Wan and Ram Woo are forced to spend a week together. Throughout their time together, they rediscover the meaning of life and reconnect with what truly matters.
title: Way Back Love

overview: After the disastrous flood in the 15th year of young Emperor Kang Xi, he opens an imperial examination to find water-control talents and get a 24-year-old genius Chen Huang. Chen cooperates with Jin Fu, a official in the same camp, to control water for more than fifty years.
title: The Long River

overview: Judi Love embarks on a culinary adventure aboard a luxury yacht, visiting fabulous locations and finding out all about local heritage and traditions, taking in the culture and incredible produce.
title: Judi Love's Culinary Cruise

overview: Sue Perkins hosts this high-stakes chess contest, following 12 rising stars of the UK's booming chess community as they battle it out via a gauntlet of brain-bending puzzles and nail-biting eliminators to be crowned champion.
title: Chess Masters: The Endgame

overview: Meet Lorna, a self-made, successful black businesswoman from South London who has worked hard to be where she is – and best friend Juliet, a woman born into the privileged gated community they both call home. Daughters Grace and Allegra are BFFs and live a life other teenagers can only dream of. A safe haven for the super-rich and their little darlings, Richford Estate is a place where bad things never happen… Until, that is, Grace and Allegra are implicated in a shocking scandal at their exclusive private school and Juliet and Lorna are forced to take sides, pushing their friendship to breaking point. As toxic secrets and lies ripple through the idyllic town, cracks within the community threaten to reveal the elitist ugliness and betrayal beneath.
title: Wild Cherry

overview: Exploring how people often have young children while their career, job, and finances demand the most from them. And how it can sometimes feel impossible to keep up and have enough energy for life, all while it seems like everyone around you has figured life out much better than you.
title: De bedste år

overview: Stacey takes five 16-18-year-olds into industries crying out for young workers to give them the ultimate work experience.
title: The Nine to Five with Stacey Dooley

overview: Return to Eden started off as a mini series in 1983 and returned in 1986 for a 22 part series. Central characters to both series were Stephanie Harper and Jilly Stewart. Stephanie and Jilly had been friends before Greg Marsden came between them and in the second series it was revealed they were in fact sisters. Jilly was the Australian version of Alexis Colby from Dynasty but got up to much worse things than Alexis. The second series took up 7 years on from where the mini series ended.
title: Return to Eden

overview: Denmark has sent over 30,000 soldiers to war over the last 30 years. In this series, they tell of the loss of innocence, about the courage and about the consequences it has had for us and for those we fought.
title: Velkommen til frontlinjen

overview: Invasion: The Normans explores the 12th Century Norman invasion of Ireland, a real-life Game of Thrones that changed the history of Europe forever.
title: Invasion: The Normans

overview: The Parasocial Social Club - ‘where you know everything about us and we know nothing about you'. Jenny and Kevin are two millennial stand-up comedians clumsily trying to get through life.
title: The Parasocial Social Club

overview: Sue Perkins embarks on an adventure along the route of the Orient Express, tracing the path through the heart of Europe, exploring vibrant cultures and stunning landscapes, and meeting the people who give each city its unique identity.
title: Sue Perkins' Big Adventure: Paris to Istanbul

overview: This groundbreaking series follows a re-enactment of a real manslaughter case, presented word-for-word with actors, before a new jury of 12 everyday Australians.
title: The Jury: Death on the Staircase

overview: Through the view of nurse María Clara Gonzales, we discover the world of a Latin American university hospital.
title: Enfermeras

overview: A festive special of Ainsley's show.
title: Ainsley's Festive Flavours

overview: The Price is Right $1,000,000 Spectacular is a special primetime version of The Price is Right where in addition to the usual (contestants try to know their prices to win big prizes), they also try to win $1,000,000.
title: The Price Is Right Million Dollar Spectacular

overview: They created a dynasty where passion rules, they are the Forresters, the first name in Fashion. The Bold and the Beautiful, a world of fashion, glamor and romance. A place where power, money and success are there for the taking in a city where dreams really do come true. Follow the lives and loves of the Forresters on The Bold and the Beautiful...
title: The Bold and the Beautiful

overview: Each series is based on the mystical stories of heroes who, at some point in their lives, turned to magicians and psychics for help. The main task of the series is to understand each story and find a way out.
title: Мистические истории

overview: Belgrade, 2003. When Serbian Prime Minister Zoran Djindjic is assassinated, the country plunges into chaos, and the authorities' response is to introduce a state of emergency. A turning point in recent Serbian history through the perspective of a journalist, a police officer, and a criminal.
title: Sablja

overview: The Baddies are back - this time bringing it to the Midwest!
title: Baddies Midwest

overview: Experience the captivating world of Norway's most influential people like never before!
title: Girls of Oslo

overview: Zhang Dabao is a middle-aged man who has lost confidence in life after facing numerous setbacks. When he unexpectedly travels back to 1995 and meets his 22-year-old self, the two embark on a journey filled with challenges that inspire them to join forces. Together, they seek to reconcile past regrets and forge a new beginning in their lives.
title: Back to 1995

overview: When Ye Wan Chu was desperate, she followed Mr. Mu back home. Unexpectedly, four years later, she would become Mr. Mu's sweetheart.
title: Saved by His Tender Love

overview: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.
title: The WONDERfools

overview: The RawlingsGold Glove Award, usually referred to as the Gold Glove Awards, is the award given annually to the Major League Baseball players judged to have exhibited superior individual fielding performances at each fielding position in both the National League (NL) and the American League (AL), as voted by the managers and coaches in each league. Managers are not permitted to vote for their own players. Additionally, a sabermetric component provided by Society for American Baseball Research (SABR) accounts for approximately 25 percent of the vote. Eighteen Gold Gloves are awarded each year (with the exception of 1957, 1985 and 2007), one at each of the nine positions in each league. In 1957, the baseball glove manufacturer Rawlings created the Gold Glove Award to commemorate the best fielding performance at each position. The award was created from a glove made from gold lamé-tanned leather and affixed to a walnut base. Initially, only one Gold Glove per position was awarded to the top fielder at each position in Major League Baseball; however, separate awards were given for the National and American Leagues beginning in 1958. In 2011, Rawlings added a Platinum Glove Award for each league, voted on by the fans.
title: Gold Glove Awards

overview: Three women join forces to prevent a sexual harassment complaint against a renowned movie director from coming to light. This controversial mission will take them to the doors of a feminist group named La Aldea, which will take them on an inward journey to heal their patriarchal wounds.
title: La Liberación

overview: In the twilight of the Gilded Age, an ensemble of the era's celebrities, including Thomas Edison, Edgar Degas and Evelyn Nesbit meet for a gathering at the house of an eccentric and failing tycoon, which turns deadly.
title: The Artist

overview: City Sessions is a new series from Amazon Music that brings together some of the biggest names in music for a series of intimate performances. Taking place at iconic venues around the globe, the series will feature artists from across genres performing new music and discussing their craft with their fans.
title: City Sessions

overview: Eight stars of screen, sport and comedy embark on the Great Aussie Road Trip with a twist in the brand-new adventure series, The Big Trip, premiering 8.30pm, Wednesday 13 November on Channel 7 and 7plus. Hosted by comedian Dave "Thorno" Thornton, The Big Trip sees four pairs of celebrity friends set out on an epic adventure across the Australian outback, with just two weeks to make it from the Great Australian Bight to Sydney's Harbour Bridge. The original format turns road tripping into a competitive sport, with the celebs facing high-stakes challenges at every turn, as they compete for the chance to gift $300,000 of hybrid and EV cars to some lucky fans. What starts as a love letter to Australia and its larrikin locals, twists and turns through white-knuckle, nail-biting moments to hilarious shenanigans, as alliances form, betrayals brew and scandals erupt with teams going to any lengths to claim victory.
title: The Big Trip

overview: From the Second World War to the 1960s, when the world was divided into East and West, this series traces the lives of six real people, including the German engineer Wernher von Braun, who rose from Nazi ranks to eventually work for NASA, the Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev and the future Prime Minister of Israel Golda Meir.
title: Die Spaltung der Welt: 1939-1962

overview: Major League Baseball Productions and FOX Sports today announced they will collaborate on a new series titled Mission October, with the first of eight episodes debuting Monday, August 26, at 7:30 p.m. ET on Fox Sports 1. The first seven episodes will be 30 minutes in length and air on Mondays at 7:30 p.m. ET. The final episode will be one hour in length and air on the Monday following the conclusion of the World Series. Mission October each week will give baseball fans an exclusive look behind the scenes with a specific team fighting to reach the Postseason and win the World Series, while also featuring the quickest turnaround of any show MLB Productions has ever created. Camera crews will follow players, coaches and front office personnel over the course of a weekend series, and each show will be produced and edited as the weekend series unfolds, allowing for episodes to air on Monday evenings each week. The debut episode will feature the rejuvenated Pittsburgh Pirates, as they battle the defending World Series Champion San Francisco Giants and seek to reach the Postseason for the first time in 21 years. The teams featured in subsequent episodes will be determined each week as the Postseason races and series develop.
title: Mission October

overview: Three hard workers cleaning women who work in a man-power company get fired. In order to survive in the big city they decide to offer their service to their old customers directly.
title: 30 שקל לשעה

overview: Male escort X is up against a younger generation who've gained a competitive edge.
title: Boy Culture: Generation X

overview: Homophobia, anxiety & fear play out in post marriage equality Australia.
title: Damaged

overview: Si Yichen, son of King Zishang, loses his entire family in a massacre on his wedding day. To seek revenge, he assumes the identity of Mu Han and gains the trust of the Eldest Princess. Meanwhile, his fiancée, Hang Anning, believing him to be dead, infiltrates the palace by swapping faces with the princess. Under the same roof, their hidden identities lead to unexpected emotions, love and vengeance become inseparable.
title: Love Behind the Mask

overview: Set during the Southern Song Dynasty, this story follows Song Ci, a judicial officer, who encounters danger while on an inspection tour. By a twist of fate, he meets Southern Opera performers Zhao Zhiting and Wang Ling, and dancer He Wenning. Despite their differences, the four join forces, solving four murder cases through investigation, interrogation, and forensic analysis, bringing justice to the deceased and fairness to the living.
title: The Song Inquisitor

overview: The Block NZ is the first local version of an international hit renovation-reality series in which four couples compete to renovate four dilapidated houses in a very upmarket suburb – room by room, week by week, challenge by challenge – and sell them at auction for the highest price. The teams can be couples, family members, or friends, and do not need any DIY experience. Once selected, the contestants live and breathe their DIY project for the nine week shoot, living on site in The Block NZ houses. There are no further eliminations, and the winning couple is decided by the toughest judge of all, the real estate market! All four renovated houses go to a live TV auction, with The Block NZ crown going to the couple whose house fetches the highest price on the night!. All the couples receive profits from the sale of their house at the televised auction.
title: The Block NZ
